answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 31779 Country: India Title: KUFU Question: DEAR HAZRAT ASSALAMUALAIKUM , WHAT IS KUFU ?I AM LOVE WITH ONE GIRL , VERY POOR FAMILY .I CAN MARRY THAT POOR GIRL. Answer ID: 31779 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 816/816/M=1432) Kufu means that the boy is not inferior to the girl in religion, lineage, wealth and education and so on: وتعتبر الکفاءۃ نسبا وحریۃ واسلاما ودیانۃ ومالا وحرفۃ الخ )الدر المختار( Loving a strange girl is unlawful. If the family of both sides are willing, you can marry the poor girl whom you like to marry. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
